headline: Kalshi Prediction Market Prices 92% Odds of Fed Rate Pause at October Meeting
summary: Data from prediction market Kalshi indicated a 92% probability that the Federal Reserve will hold its target rate range steady at 3.75%-4% at its October 28 meeting.
why: Short-term rate expectations dictate liquidity conditions, foreign exchange valuations, and equity discount rates globally.

impacts.name: US Dollar
impacts.why: High probability of steady rates keeps near-term borrowing rate expectations locked in.
